MAYORS FOR GOOD GOVERNANCE BACK MAGALONG

The Mayors for Good Governance (M4GG) expressed full support for Baguio City Mayor Benjamin "Benjie" Magalong, citing his consistent record of integrity, independence, and accountability in public service.

In a statement issued September 27, the group — led by Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto, Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte, Isabela City Mayor Sitti Hataman, Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo, Kauswagan Vice Mayor Rommel Arnado, and former Dumaguete City Mayor Ipe Remollo — said Magalong has "consistently defended the common good against entrenched interests" in Baguio and the Cordillera by regulating overdevelopment, protecting the environment, and confronting corruption.

The group also highlighted Magalong's national roles, including leading the Board of Inquiry on the Mamasapano tragedy and exposing the "ninja cops" controversy, where he stood by his principles despite pressure, intimidation, and personal risk.

"These choices send one clear message: Mayor Magalong cannot be bought, bullied, or swayed by favors or threats," M4GG said.

The group called on the public to rally behind Magalong's leadership, describing him as proof that "leaders of character still exist" at a time when trust in institutions is eroded.

M4GG said it remains committed to the long-term fight for truth, accountability, and principled leadership.
